verdict.rationale: EFTPS is an online federal tax payment service, so issuing scoped API credentials to an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no API and no credential-scoping mechanism: probes for OpenAPI specs all return 404, and the documented software channel is the Batch Provider program rather than an API. Human sign-in through Login.gov or ID.me (MFA), PIV/CAC for federal agency users, and multi-client logins for tax professionals are adjacent authentication features, not scoped agent credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
